Conversation.note: Two full turns rendered through the host's renderTurnRow inside a bounded, clipped chat surface: user bubbles right, assistant markdown left, correct row spacing.

WithPendingPrompt.note: optimisticPrompt renders through renderPendingPromptRow with the ThinkingText 'Queued' trailing status under it, below the settled turns.

WithOlderHistory.note: history.hasOlderHistory + isLoadingOlderHistory renders the history loading row (spinner) above the first turn.

ContentSearchActive.note: contentSearch={{query}} lights the transcript-level paint layer: every 'composer' match in both turns is highlighted, proving the view wires ChatContentSearchQueryContext for its rows.
